cohort: 14,482 surgical patients admitted to 7 Medecins Sans Frontieres (MSF) hospitals in the Eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, Central African Republic, and South Sudan between 2011 and 2013
finding: Perioperative mortality varied by age group and type of procedure, with higher rates for children, emergency surgeries, and violence-related injuries.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was the most common major procedure and had a 30-day perioperative mortality rate of 5.28 per 1,000 admissions.
country: Democratic Republic of Congo, Central African Republic, South Sudan
